info.name: raStack
info.description: Right ascension from stack detections, weighted mean value across filters, in equinox J2000.  See StackObjectThin for stack epoch information.

info.name: decStack

info.description: Modified Julian Date of the mean epoch corresponding to raMean, decMean (equinox J2000).
